newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Antah wins toll road contract.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Antah wins toll road contract.

text.p: Antah Holdings Bhd said on Thursday it has won a contract to build a 46.5-km toll road linking the central states of Selangor and Negri Sembilan.
Total investment cost of the project is estimated at 1.0 billion ringgit, Antah said in a statement.
It said construction is expected to start early next year, and would take three years to complete.
Antah, which was given a 33-year concession, said it would further negotiate with the government on the final terms and conditions of the concession agreement.
The project is expected to enhance the group's future earnings through the collection of toll over the concession period, it said.

To facilitate the listing of the infrastructure project on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, Antah said it has proposed that the project be undertaken by its wholly-owned subsidiary, Kaseh Lebuhraya Sdn Bhd.
Shares of the property developer were suspended since Tuesday at the company's request pending an announcement. The stock closed at 3.38 ringgit on Monday.
